entries.answer: Mainly skipping a safety interlock or an inspection criterion, failing to stop in time on an equipment deviation, an insufficiently evaluated test proposal, inaccurate technical documentation and checklists, a breach of confidentiality and information security, and the personnel fatigue caused by long standby periods and night flying. Confirming step by step to the procedure and the checklist, stopping decisively on the stop criteria, keeping the documentation version controlled and recording faithfully are the basic controls; the specific safety rules follow armed-forces documents.
